jobs.title: Mobile Software Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description:
About Us

Fashion Nova is the world’s leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.

Founder & CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online– powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.

Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!

The brand’s name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.

Role Overview

Fashion Nova is building a world-class engineering team to power our next phase of growth. We’re investing heavily in scalable, high-impact technology platforms—and we’re looking for a Mobile Software Engineer
with strong React Native
experience to help bring them to life.

In this role, you’ll design and build high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android
, collaborating closely with product, design, and platform teams. You’ll play a key role in shaping our mobile architecture, delivering polished user experiences, and contributing to a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

Build pixel-perfect, buttery-smooth UIs across iOS and Android
Architect and develop reusable, scalable UI components
Optimize application performance, reliability, and maintainability
Leverage native APIs for deep platform integrations
Debug and resolve performance bottlenecks and production issues
Write clean, well-documented code and maintain automated test coverage
Partner with product and design to deliver innovative mobile experiences
Engage with the open-source community to help improve mission-critical tooling (React Native moves fast!)

What You Bring

3+ years of experience with React and/or React Native
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript (ES6+)
Experience building testable, maintainable codebases and APIs
Solid understanding of third-party dependencies and conflict resolution
Familiarity with native build tools (Xcode, CocoaPods)
Experience with automated testing (Jest, Appium, Playwright)
Knowledge of mobile performance, memory management, and multithreading

Nice to Have

Experience with Shopify APIs, GraphQL, Firebase
Exposure to Swift and/or Kotlin
App Store and Google Play publishing experience
CI/CD pipelines, Sauce Labs, or mobile automation infrastructure

Benefits

New State-of-the-art HQ located in Beverly Hills
Formalized career paths for continued professional growth
Comprehensive health insurance across Medical, Dental and Vision
401k match, with immediate vesting upon eligibility
Weekly catered lunches & fully-stock kitchen pantry!
Opportunities to travel for trade shows and vendor meetings
Summer Fridays Early Departure
Team bonding events and programs
Attractive employee discounts!

Fashion Nova, LLC, and subsidiaries thereof, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are steadfast in our commitment to equal employment opportunities and pledge that these objectives are reflected in all aspects of our daily operations. We will continue to recruit, hire, train, and advance in employment qualified individuals in all job titles without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, status as a protected veteran, criminal history, or status as an individual with a disability; and shall not discriminate against any individual, any such characteristic, nor any other classification protected by local, state and|or federal law.

Professional written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
Foundational experience in at least one of the following, with genuine interest in learning the other: Python, C#/.NET, or Next.js/TypeScript.

Does the opportunity to develop and produce high performance systems excite you?

Do you thrive when given the freedom to innovate?

Join our world-class Edge Technology organization

The Edge Platform team plans, builds, maintains, and operates a global platform, ensuring reliable availability and performance for customers. It designs, develops, and deploys essential technologies, including hardware, software, and network infrastructure, supporting all products.

Partner with the best

Our team provides support to several other teams at Akamai who require secure delivery. Our work centers around building systems which operate at large scale, with high resilience and performance.

As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for:

Designing and developing systems capable of handling tens of thousands of concurrent operations
Developing software to make efficient use of Relational Database Management Systems and NoSQL databases
Creating new features from scratch, enhancing existing features and optimizing existing functionality
Following good development methodology, including collaboration with testing and SQA departments to successfully deploy new system components

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Possess academic or project-based training in Java and familiarity with Python, C++, or Bash in Linux/Unix environments
Have hands-on project experience with Spring and Spring Boot frameworks for building scalable backend applications
Have hands-on project experience with UI technologies through academic or practical project experience using Angular for front-end development solutions.
Demonstrate foundational understanding or project coursework in Terraform.
Demonstrate understanding of SQL, relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Postgres), and NoSQL databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, Cassandra) through projects.

About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge:
Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:
We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Junior Software Developer

Location:
McLean, VA (Hybrid)

Company:

BLN24 

About Us:

We find strength in teamwork-a better you is a better us 
BLN24 is an award-winning Management Consulting Firm that supports the U.S. Federal Government in successfully achieving their mission and goals. Our service and solutions delivery start with understanding each client’s end-state, and then seamlessly integrating within each Agency’s organization to improve and enhance strategic and technical operations and deployments. 

Job Overview:

BLN24 is seeking a Junior Software Developer to support NOAA's modernization of mission-critical weather and data dissemination systems. Working as part of an Agile development team and with mentorship from senior engineers, the developer will help review legacy weather applications, which typically ingest, route, and deliver weather products, and convert them into secure, event-driven, cloud-native applications on AWS in support of the National Weather Service. The ideal candidate is eager to learn modern cloud technologies, enjoys solving technical challenges, and thrives in a collaborative environment delivering solutions that improve NOAA's capabilities. 

Role and Responsibilities:

   Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs (primarily Python) that carry forward legacy application workflows, including administrative and subscription-management functions. 

Build and update user-facing features using modern front-end technologies (e.g., React) that work across a wide range of browsers and devices. 

Develop event-driven, message-processing components on AWS (e.g., Lambda, SQS, S3) and the data-access layer for relational databases. 

Study legacy code and documentation to understand how existing systems behave, and help write design documents, API contracts, and workflow diagrams that preserve that behavior in the cloud version. 

Add structured logging, audit trails, and correlation-ID tracing so issues can be followed across components. 

Write automated tests, test simulators, and mocks, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, including security-scan gates. 

Fix security findings and vulnerable dependencies, following least-privilege access practices and government security requirements. 

Contribute to application deployments and AWS infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers. 

Collaborate with teammates, QA, DevSecOps, and government stakeholders, and participate in demos and knowledge-transfer sessions. 

Learn additional applications in the portfolio over time, with mentorship, as program priorities evolve. 

Required Skills/Abilities, Experience
   Education and experience:
Bachelor’s degree or Bachelor’s degree in-progress in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field 

Back-end development:
Experience building backend services or APIs in Python, or in another server-side language (e.g., Java or C#/.NET) with the ability to learn Python quickly. 

Databases:
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL). 

Testing:
Experience writing automated unit tests (e.g., pytest or similar). 

Tools and processes:
Experience with Git and familiarity with agile development practices. 

Cloud:
Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform through work, coursework, personal projects, or certification. 

U.S. Citizenship Required: 
Proof of
U.S. Citizenship and eligibility for Public Trust clearance. 

Other Desired Skills/Abilities, Experience
   Front-end experience with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, and a modern framework (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js). 

Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, ECS, EC2, or RDS. 

AWS certification (e.g., Cloud Practitioner or Developer – Associate). 

Familiarity with Python web and data frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, SQLAlchemy). 

Experience with database design and query optimization in PostgreSQL or SQL Server. 

Experience with integration testing and CI/CD pipelines. 

Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation). 

Familiarity with Docker and containerized environments (e.g., ECS or Kubernetes). 

Experience reading and modernizing legacy code (e.g., Java, C/C++, or C#/.NET). 

Experience with application security practices such as vulnerability remediation and secrets management. 

Experience with logging and observability tools and practices. 

Familiarity with federal government environments. 

Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) responsibly, within security and data-handling policies. 

What BLN24 brings to the Game: 

BLN24 benefits are game changing. We like our team to play hard and that means they need to be taken care of — physically, financially, and emotionally. We make sure to keep them in the game by giving them access to generous medical, dental, and vision plans.  You can join one of the fastest growing companies headquartered in the Washington DC Metro Area.  We give you the opportunity to work in different sectors, so you have the chance at variety while maintaining stability. 

Flexibility at BLN24 allows each individual the opportunity to balance quality work and their personal lives. Depending on projects, we allow remote working opportunities so you can always be in the game no matter where you call home. 

BLN24 is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We believe people are our strength and  understand  diverse talents  are  key to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. In accordance with applicable law, we make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as any mental health or physical disability needs.

About The Position

The County of Riverside’s District Attorney’s Office is seeking to fill a Software Engineer II to support the District Attorney Office in Riverside.

The Software Engineering team within the Riverside County District Attorney’s office has designed and built a sophisticated software platform entirely in-house to support the complex operations of a modern DA legal environment. The system spans multiple modules, including case management, transaction processing, reporting, data management, and real-time integrations with external agencies, all tailored to meet evolving business and compliance needs. As a Software Engineer II, incumbents will play a key role in shaping and scaling this critical platform. Incumbents will work alongside a sharp, collaborative team with strong technical backgrounds in computer science and engineering; people who care deeply about code quality, system architecture, and long-term impact. This is a unique chance to work on meaningful, large-scale projects with the autonomy to innovate and the support of smart peers within a stable public sector environment. If you are looking for challenging work that truly matters, submit an application today!

Applicants who are currently enrolled in their third or fourth year of college, majoring in computer science or computer engineering, are highly desired. Competitive candidates will have demonstrated experience in at least one of the following programming languages or frameworks: C#, C++, Angular, Java, JavaScript, and React.js.

The Software Engineer II is distinguished from the Software Engineer I in that the latter is the entry-level classification in the series. This class is further distinguished from the Senior Software Engineer in that the latter requires incumbent to lead the team responsible for developing and implementing complex algorithms, data structures, and data models. Advancement to the next level is obtained by competitive selection through an open recruitment.

Meet The Team!

The District Attorney of Riverside County , as the public prosecutor acting on behalf of the People, vigorously enforces the law, pursues the truth, protects those victimized by crime, exonerates the innocent, and safeguards the rights of all to ensure that justice is done on behalf of our community. The office’s staff of over 700 is comprised of prosecuting attorneys, sworn investigators, victim-witness advocates, paralegals, investigative technicians, forensic analysts, and a wide range of information technology and supporting staff all committed to excellence and integrity in public service. We are, and we seek to maintain, a diverse workforce to match a diverse county.

Develop and build software systems components, Web APIs and Services.
Understand existing design patterns in the software and follow existing code in implementing new features.
Contribute to front end design using TypeScript, SASS, Bootstrap and with backend development.
Troubleshoot front-end software issues using browser debugging and monitoring tools.
Build intermediate level SQL queries, Stored Procedures, and help generate reports.
Maintain scheduled tasks on the server and scheduled jobs on the database.
Add intermediate level features into software systems.
Ensure software features continue to work properly after maintenance and testing.
Investigate and resolve software errors in the application using various troubleshooting tools.
Troubleshoot software issues that may arise in the development and testing environment.
Work closely with department representatives in the development of software programming applications and testing of new features.
Maintain software configurations, library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree in computer science,computer/software engineering, information technology, or related technical fields. Applicants who have completed atleast three years of college education (90 semester units or 135 quarter units) in one of the mentioned fields maysubstitute additional qualifying experience in system analysis, software programming, or software engineering for theremaining required education on the basis of one year of relevant, full-time experience equaling 30 semester units or 45quarter units of education.

Experience:
Two years of software engineering in web front end and backend development. Experience must be recent and continuous including hands-on experience in a diverse array of programming languages such as .Net Core, C++, C#, TypeScript, SQL and frameworks including NodeJS, Angular. Additionally, proficiency in essential technologies such as SASS, Bootstrap, Web API, Shared Libraries, MSSQL, T-SQL, and Stored Procedures is required. Intermediate level experience in DevOps is preferred.

Knowledge of:
The principles, methods, and techniques in software engineering in web front end and backend development; data structures; algorithm analysis; computer organization and architecture; compiler (front-end parser); relational databases; operating systems; backend development in an object-oriented language; automata and formal languages or computational theory; systems configurations, library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories; networking or distributed computing; source control and NuGet packages.

Ability to:
Build user friendly software systems; employ a systematic and structured approach to software engineering; monitor and troubleshoot software errors; communicate technical details clearly and succinctly; take initiatives to learn new technologies; understand technical requirements and follow detailed technical instructions; work in a fast paced but flexible environment; collaborate and work as part of a team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Reconciliation & Reporting
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, the projects you own will have direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

You will help build and operate the systems that ingest and integrate global card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, and reconcile them against internal payment data to power settlement, dispute, cost, tax, and regulatory reporting. You will own well-scoped projects within this platform end-to-end, with guidance from more experienced engineers. Our vision is to make reconciliation and reporting accurate, automated, and near real-time.

You Will

Own small, well-bounded projects end-to-end with guidance available: clarify requirements, design, build, test, ship, and follow up.
Build and maintain features within the ingestion and reconciliation pipelines that match card-network and partner reports against internal transaction data.
Contribute to tooling that provides end-to-end traceability of money throughout the system.
Develop features for reporting and reconciliation products that are accurate, reliable, timely, scalable, and user-friendly for both internal finance teams and external merchants.
Produce standardized journals and summaries that feed downstream accounting, audit, and analysis.
Contribute to our large-scale tax and regulatory reporting systems, including US IRS information returns (the 1099 family, issued at the scale of tens of millions of forms annually to merchants and customers) and international regimes such as EU-wide CESOP and country-specific reporting for Australia, Ireland, and Spain.
Support broader regulatory and compliance obligations (AML, KYC, and similar), with careful handling of sensitive and PII data, including TIN validation and secure form generation and filing.
Validate your work before calling it done, using code review, tests, small experiments, or usage signals, including for AI-assisted changes.
Take agency in debugging and escalating production issues across services, giving the team clear context on what changed, when it changed, how it changed, and what risk remains.
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, data analysts, and finance, tax, and compliance partners, contributing to technical design and product decisions that shape feature outcomes.
Review peers' work, apply their feedback to your own, and document learnings, including AI workflows the team can reuse.
Opportunistically improve the systems you touch when it fits your project scope, replacing manual and redundant work with automation, and route larger issues to the right owner.

You Have

3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience.
A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar) or equivalent technical experience.
Experience building or maintaining batch- or event-driven data pipelines, with exposure to workflow-orchestration technologies (e.g., Airflow, Temporal, Spark, or equivalent) and a working understanding of distributed systems.
Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, Python, Go) and solid SQL.
Experience delivering well-scoped projects or features end-to-end (design, build, test, ship, operate), with guidance from more experienced engineers.
Strong communication skills: you surface concerns alongside a concrete proposal, and you give teammates clear context when debugging and escalating.
Care for engineering quality, including maintainable and testable code, code review, CI/CD, and observability, appropriate for a complex, high-stakes financial environment.
Proficiency in using AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle, with the judgment to recognize where they accelerate work and where output needs additional validation.

Nice to Have

Exposure to financial, tax, regulatory, or payments reporting and reconciliation products.
Familiarity with the payments ecosystem (merchants, acquirers, card networks, and issuers/processors), including authorization, clearing, and settlement, card-network settlement file formats, or ISO-8583.
Understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation processes.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) or distributed data systems and tools such as Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Kafka, and Hadoop.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Interest in financial products and markets.

jobs.title: Analysis Software Engineer II - Chemical Insights Research Institute
jobs.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for an Analysis Software Engineer II
at UL Research Institutes, based in our Morrisville, North Carolina office.

The Analysis Software Engineer II designs, develops, and maintains high-quality software applications and data pipelines in support of Underwriters Laboratories Research Institutes’ (ULRI) Chemical Insights mission to provide unbiased research on chemicals and their risks to people’s health.

The Analysis Software Engineer II is a key contributor on project teams to define specifications for complex software programming applications and modifies existing applications. The role requires strong proficiency in data science tools and web technologies for building durable data pipelines and full-stack software applications. The role requires a collaborative mindset, and the ability to turn complex scientific requirements into scalable, high-quality software solutions.

UL Research Institutes

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Chemical Insights teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

Chemical Insights Research Institute (CIRI)

The Chemical Insights Research Institute (CIRI) contributes to the protection of public health and well-being by conducting scientific research. Our research and initiatives let people around the world know what chemicals are in the air we breathe and how they affect human health and the planet. We share our research and knowledge through information and application tools with leaders in the scientific, business, and policy communities to raise awareness of human health risks stemming from emerging technologies. To learn more, visit: chemicalinsights.org/.

What You’ll Learn And Achieve

As the Analysis Software Engineer II, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

Design, build, and maintain Python-based data pipelines for ingesting, cleaning, transforming, and validating scientific data, as well as web-based applications and REST APIs for scientific data curation and evaluation.
Collaborate with scientific technical experts, UX/UI designers, software engineers, and other developers to deliver features that meet user needs and research goals.
Integrate applications with databases, APIs, laboratory information systems, high-performance computing (HPC) systems, and external scientific data sources.
Design and implement programmatic REST APIs for seamless integration between services.
Write unit and integration tests for reliable, durable software applications.
Assist internal scientists and engineers in using data pipelines and applications; maintain effective documentation of these systems for internal users.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in software engineering.
Plan and prioritize project activities, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
Communicate project status, risks, and technical challenges to stakeholders and senior management.
Mentor colleagues in software engineering best practices.

Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback on findings, both verbal and in writing.

Perform other duties as directed.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:
We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Ads Tooling
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The ads system at TikTok operates on a massive scale and serves millions of advertisers, clients and influencers across the world. The quality of the ads system depends heavily on the underlying infrastructure that handles massive data. The USDS Ads team empowers TikTok's global monetization by efficiently delivering ads and content on TikTok.

Tooling is what makes changing that system fast — and safe. Ads correctness cannot be asserted by comparing an expected string to an actual one: ranking outputs are probabilistic, behavior is driven as much by configuration as by code, and a silent regression in a prediction pipeline costs revenue long before it triggers an alert. Off-the-shelf test frameworks don't cover this, so we build our own. You will build the platforms and tooling that let every engineer on the team validate their changes — automated validation across ads pipelines, and continuous system-health monitoring that protects business metrics. Just as importantly, you'll go looking for the manual, repetitive, and error-prone workflows our engineers live with today, and replace them with automation.

You'll join a team that invests in your growth — with mentorship from senior engineers, ownership of real surfaces from early on, and a clear path toward technical leadership.

Responsibilities:
- Build and own the internal tooling and platforms that power ads system validation — test frameworks, environment and data provisioning, assertion libraries, and self-service harnesses that let engineers validate changes without hand-rolling infrastructure each time.
- Identify inefficient engineering workflows and automate them away. Audit how the team actually works today — manual verification steps, repeated debugging rituals, slow feedback loops, high-toil release procedures — quantify the cost, and build the tooling that eliminates it.
- Build quality infrastructure for ads systems, including training/serving consistency checks, prediction-service invariant and fallback validation.
- Build automated system-health monitoring that surfaces regressions in business and quality metrics, routes findings to the owning engineer with enough context to act, and shortens time-to-detection.
- Integrate tooling into CI/CD as release gates, so validation runs by default rather than by remembering to run it.
- Treat internal engineers as your users — measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate on developer experience rather than shipping tools and walking away.
- Bring in new ideas and tooling, including applying LLM and agent-based approaches to test generation, failure triage, and coverage analysis.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer science or related technical disciplines.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, developer tooling, quality engineering, or test infrastructure for complex and scalable distributed systems.
- Track record of building tooling or frameworks used by other engineers — not only authoring tests within an existing framework.
- Hands-on authorship of CI/CD pipelines including release-gating logic.
- Demonstrated instinct for spotting repetitive or manual engineering work and replacing it with automation, with measurable results.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in the Ads domain — auction mechanics, bidding, ranking, attribution, or billing.
- Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering-efficiency tooling, or test infrastructure adopted across a team or org.
- Experience testing or validating large-scale ranking and machine learning infrastructure, including model evaluation, A/B experiment correctness, or online/offline consistency.
- Applied LLM/agent tooling for engineering workflows, including structured-output schema design.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About DelRicht Research

DelRicht Research is a national network of integrated clinical research sites embedded within physicians’ practices that offer the benefit of a dedicated research team with the support of a centralized team.

Our clinical trials provide new treatment options for our patients, and ultimately our goal is to move medicine forward by getting new medications FDA approved. Presently our network stretches across 33 clinical research sites throughout the United States in 18 states.

As DelRicht scales, technology and data are becoming central to how we operate. We are building a modern, integrated data and AI platform — and this role is a core part of that foundation.

The Role

This is a high-ownership engineering role for someone who thinks in systems. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining DelRicht's data platform, cloud infrastructure, integration architecture, and AI-powered applications — working across every layer from source systems to operational tools.

Our environment is built on Google Cloud Platform and the broader Google ecosystem. The ideal candidate is deeply comfortable in that stack and brings hands-on experience building AI-augmented workflows using tools such as Vertex AI, Gemini API, Document AI, and LLM-based tooling including Claude and Claude Code.

You will work directly with our existing Data Scientists and business stakeholders to turn operational problems into reliable, scalable, automated solutions.

What You'll Own

Data Platform & Architecture

Maintain and evolve DelRicht's centralized BigQuery data warehouse — schemas, datasets, data models, and access controls
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines connecting clinical, operational, financial, and CRM source systems
Design and implement dev, staging, and production environment structure across the data platform
Establish data governance, documentation, and pipeline monitoring standards
Optimize BigQuery performance, query structure, and cost management
Partner with analysts to build trusted, reusable data models rather than one-off datasets

Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

Design and maintain GCP infrastructure across Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and IAM
Build and own CI/CD pipelines for data and application deployments
Establish infrastructure-as-code practices and environment parity (dev → staging → production)
Manage service account security, least-privilege access, and GCP IAM governance
Monitor pipelines, set alerting, and maintain platform reliability

AI & Automation

Build and maintain AI-powered pipelines and applications using Vertex AI, Gemini API, Document AI, and related Google AI services
Work fluently with LLM-based development tools including Claude and Claude Code as part of day-to-day engineering workflows
Develop automation that replaces manual, spreadsheet-driven processes with scalable, reliable systems
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling where it creates genuine operational leverage

Integrations & APIs

Build and maintain integrations across operational systems including CRIO, Salesforce, Greenhouse, and financial platforms
Design scalable API integrations using REST, webhooks, and managed platforms such as Fivetran
Own integration reliability, monitoring, and failure handling
Maintain and improve MuleSoft or successor integration middleware where applicable

Google Workspace & Apps Script

Build automation and lightweight applications integrated with Google Sheets, Drive, Gmail, and Workspace APIs
Migrate manual Sheets-based workflows to purpose-built, maintainable solutions
Develop advanced Apps Script solutions as operational bridges while longer-term platform solutions are built

Application Development

Build internal tools and lightweight applications that support operational teams
Write clean Python and/or Node.js backend code for services, APIs, and automation
Develop simple front-end interfaces where needed — comfort with React or equivalent is a plus, but this is not primarily a frontend role

What We're Looking For

Required

4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or a closely related technical discipline
Strong, hands-on BigQuery experience — data modeling, SQL optimization, schema design
Fluency in Python for data pipelines, API integrations, and automation
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud environment
Hands-on GCP experience across Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and IAM
Experience building and maintaining REST API integrations and webhooks
Strong understanding of environment management (dev/staging/production), CI/CD pipelines, and deployment practices
Experience with service account security and cloud IAM governance
Strong SQL skills and ability to write complex analytical queries
Ability to take technical projects from business requirements through production deployment independently
Strong communication skills — able to work directly with non-technical stakeholders

Strongly Preferred

Hands-on experience with Vertex AI, Gemini API, Document AI, or comparable AI/ML cloud services
Experience working with LLM-based tooling (Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI, or similar) in a production or near-production context
Experience with Fivetran or comparable managed integration platforms
Salesforce integration experience — APIs, data model understanding, or middleware
Looker or Looker Studio dashboard and data model development
Google Apps Script development
Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or Cloud Deployment Manager)
Experience in healthcare, clinical research, or another regulated industry

Nice to Have

Familiarity with HIPAA and clinical data privacy requirements
Experience with data orchestration tools such as Airflow or comparable
Docker and containerization experience
Frontend development experience (React, TypeScript)
Experience with n8n or similar workflow automation platforms

What Success Looks Like

In your first six months, you will have a clear understanding of DelRicht's full data and integration architecture, have contributed meaningfully to pipeline reliability and environment structure, and have shipped at least one automation or integration that materially reduces manual work for an operational team.

Over the first year, you will be a trusted technical owner of DelRicht's data platform — capable of taking projects independently from requirements to production, building AI-augmented workflows that scale with the business, and helping establish the engineering standards that support DelRicht's next stage of growth.

Why DelRicht Research

This is a rare opportunity to have genuine ownership across an organization's entire data and technology infrastructure at a moment when that infrastructure is actively being built. You will work on real operational problems, ship tools that teams use every day, and help define the technical architecture that carries the company forward.

We are building a modern, AI-native data platform in a domain — clinical research — where the work directly impacts patient outcomes and the advancement of medicine. If you enjoy building, owning outcomes, and working at the intersection of data, AI, and real operational complexity, this is the right environment.

DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry.With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's fraud and anti-money laundering (AML) solutions scale infinitely and enable organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time.Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide significant performance lift from day one.DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership compared to legacy point solutions.DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.
Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven.Come join us!

Role Summary
We are hiring a Software Engineer to build the automation that lets a small team deliver fraud and AML solutions to many clients at once.
You will build internal tooling the Solutions team uses every day — Claude Code plugins, skills and MCP servers in our internal plugin marketplace — and integrate them with our AI Sandbox, the Vera platform, and the APIs behind them. You will also work directly on client onboarding: standing up tenants from solution templates, parsing third-party data and responses, wiring up integrations, and validating end to end that the right alerts actually fire.
This is a production software engineering role. What we are really hiring for is the instinct to turn something one client needed into something every client gets. Machine learning experience is not required, and neither is a fraud or AML background — both are learnable, and we would rather have an engineer who ships.
This role is open at both junior and senior levels.

Primary responsibilities
Build Automation Tooling: Design and ship the plugins, skills and MCP servers the Solutions team runs — tenant creation, configuration copying, onboarding flows, on-call helpers — in Python and shell.
Make It Reusable: Turn one-off solutions into tooling that works for every client. This is the core of the job, not an afterthought.
Integrate with the Platform: Connect tooling to the AI Sandbox, Vera and internal platform APIs, and keep it working across sandbox, preprod and production tenants.
Support Client Onboarding: Work hands-on on live onboardings — tenant setup from templates, schema and response parsing, third-party integrations over SFTP and API, and end-to-end validation that the right alerts fire.
Serve Your Users: What you build is used by core engineering, product, delivery, customer support and technical account management. Understanding what each of them needs, and keeping them informed, is part of the work.
Own Your Projects: Scope, sequence and deliver your own work, and say clearly where it stands.

Requirements
Qualifications
Experience: At least 1 year of full-time professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Internships are not counted toward this minimum. We are open on level — we care more about what you have built than how long you have been building.
Education: BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering. MS preferred. We also consider other STEM degrees alongside a record of shipped production software.
Shipped Software: Demonstrated experience delivering working software end to end — not prototypes or notebooks.
Coding Proficiency: Strong, production-grade Python — the primary language for this team's automation and tooling. Java is expected for senior candidates and preferred for junior ones: our core platform is built in Java, and you will work across both over time. Comfort with shell, and with reading unfamiliar codebases, matters as much as either language.
Cloud and Containers: Experience with AWS and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Built for Others: Evidence of building something other people then used — an internal tool, a library, a plugin, a template, a service another team depends on.
Collaboration and Ownership: Able to work across team boundaries, take end-to-end ownership, and operate where the path is not already defined.

Preferred qualifications
Java, if you are applying at a junior level — our core platform is built in it.
TypeScript — solution features often land in our front end.
LLM-powered agent workflows — LangChain/LangGraph, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling or RAG — for production or internal platforms.
Distributed data frameworks such as Spark, Kafka or Flink.
Experience deploying or maintaining machine learning models in production.
Analytical databases and large-scale data exploration (ClickHouse or other columnar stores).
Real-time decision engines or stateful stream processing.
Domain knowledge in fraud or risk — a plus, never a requirement.

Benefits
Base Salary: 130K – 250K
Total Compensation: Includes Base + Performance Bonus + Equity Options.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Discretionary Time Off Policy (DTO) and paid holidays.
Opportunities for R&D exploration and professional development.
Regular team-building events and a collaborative, innovative culture.

Backed by top VC firms, we are poised to disrupt the billion-dollar engineering simulation industry with our fast-growing trajectory.

We are seeking a hands-on software engineer to work on security projects across our web application, AWS, and on-premises high-performance computing environment. This is a crucial role in supporting the company’s growth into regulated industries.

What You Will Do

Build and integrate technical security features and controls into our web application and internal administration platforms
Implement and maintain AWS security controls, including IAM, encryption, backups, logging, monitoring, and alerting
Securely orchestrate customer jobs and data across cloud and HPC environments
Build and respond to alerts from security logs covering both cloud and on-premises hardware
Deploy and manage vulnerability scanning tooling; collaborate with developers to triage and remediate findings
Fix and validate remediations of penetration test findings
Harden and secure on-premises HPC infrastructure
Maintain and improve compliance tooling integrations, identify gaps, and drive remediation efforts

Requirements

Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of:

Backend software engineering
DevOps / Infrastructure engineering
Security engineering, with a focus on building than maintenance

Experience securing cloud environments, ideally AWS

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform)

Experience deploying or working with CI/CD pipelines

Working knowledge of application and infrastructure security fundamentals

Must be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder

What We're Looking For

We are looking for backend software engineers, devops engineers, or security engineers, as long as you are hands on and are interested in security. You will join a team of infrastructure engineers in an engineering-first company which is at the frontiers of HPC-based simulations. This is a role primarily focused on writing code.

Ideally you have experience in one or more of: building NIST 800-171 or NIST 800-53, compliance automation platforms, infrastructure-as-code, AWS security, developing CI/CD pipelines

SET THE COURSE

This position helps bring Tommy Bahama’s island-lifestyle brand to life online, contributing to intuitive and inspiring digital experiences that deepen customer engagement and drive B2C eCommerce growth. Working closely with and learning from the Lead Front End Web Developer and senior team members, this role builds foundational front-end skills while supporting Creative, Marketing, and Development in delivering an online shopping journey that reflects the quality customers expect from the brand.

What You’ll Build

Product pages that make it easy to fall for the next hero print. Search and navigation that get customers to what they want, fast. Seasonal launches and campaigns that land flawlessly on day one. Checkout flows that stay out of the customer’s way. These are the moments you’ll build, refine, and own.

WHY JOIN US

You’ll join a small, tight-knit development team where your ideas are heard and your code ships fast. We build with modern tools — Angular, TypeScript, and AI-assisted development — on a brand with real momentum and a customer base that notices the details. You’ll get hands-on mentorship from experienced developers, exposure to real production work from day one, and a clear path to grow your skills and take on more ownership over time.

BE THE ISLAND GUIDE

Key Responsibilities

You’ll help turn creative vision into a shopping experience customers love — writing code for features big and small, with support and feedback from senior developers along the way.

Develop front‑end features using the Angular framework, TypeScript/NgRx, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, translating creative designs into clean, working code for a B2C eCommerce platform, with guidance and code review from senior developers.
Integrate and consume SAP REST OCC APIs to support dynamic application functionality.
Build and maintain integrations with third‑party platforms including Adobe Dynamic Media, Google Maps, Bazaarvoice, Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager, Klaviyo, and others.
Support CMS‑driven site content and develop new CMS components, templates, and features.
Deliver a polished, pixel-perfect experience across every browser, platform, and viewport our customers use.
Develop and maintain responsive, mobile‑first website experiences optimized for phones, tablets, and desktops.
Implement SEO‑focused development practices for eCommerce, including SSR, structured data, canonical URLs, sitemaps, and an understanding of AEO/GEO considerations.
Execute time‑sensitive website updates such as promotional events, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.
Assist with gathering requirements and communicating with non‑technical stakeholders, with support from senior developers on more complex or ambiguous requests.
Troubleshoot and resolve straightforward usability, performance, and functional issues, escalating more complex problems to senior developers.
Team up with Creative to bring bold designs to life — building, implementing, and testing pages, interactive components, and UI enhancements customers will actually notice.
Stay curious about emerging web technologies and practices, and bring new ideas to the team for discussion.
Build and test UI components for WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance, including semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and screen reader compatibility.
Write and maintain automated unit and end-to-end tests (e.g., Jasmine/Karma, Cypress) to ensure code quality and prevent regressions.
Implement and maintain analytics and tag management integrations (e.g., Adobe Analytics/GA4, Adobe Launch/Google Tag Manager) to support site tracking and reporting.
Manage day-to-day tasks with guidance from the Lead Front End Web Developer and project management, prioritizing work as directed.
Actively participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving feedback — to build technical skills and absorb team coding standards and best practices.

Essentials For Life In Paradise

1–3 years of hands‑on web development experience
Core Technical Skills: Foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; exposure to Angular and TypeScript (through coursework, projects, or professional experience)
Preferred Technical Skills: NgRx, REST APIs, SCSS, Git, JSON, familiarity with a CMS platform such as Adobe Experience Manager, and interest in using AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT)
Accessibility, Testing & Analytics: Willingness to learn and apply WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines, automated testing frameworks (e.g., Jasmine/Karma, Cypress), and analytics/tag management tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, GA4, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager); prior exposure is a plus
Exposure to designing, developing, or testing B2C eCommerce or other consumer-facing websites (preferred, not required)
Familiarity with CMS platforms or components is a plus
Ability to collaborate effectively with external vendors and internal business stakeholders
Eagerness to learn, take feedback well, and grow into greater ownership of tasks and technical challenges over time
Working knowledge of relational databases (plus)
Experience with SAP Commerce Cloud Composable Framework (plus)
Familiarity with IDEs such as Eclipse or Visual Studio Code

Rate Range: $93,000.00 to $115,000.00 Annually

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Clinically AI

Clinically AI is a rapidly scaling healthcare AI company transforming how behavioral health and healthcare organizations manage clinical documentation, compliance workflows, chart auditing, and operational efficiency through artificial intelligence.

Our platform helps clinicians, compliance teams, administrators, and healthcare organizations reduce administrative burden, improve documentation quality, strengthen audit readiness, and operate more efficiently. We operate at the intersection of AI, healthcare operations, workflow design, and real-world clinical execution, where adoption, trust, usability, and measurable outcomes matter.

The Opportunity

This opportunity places you at the center of a rapidly scaling engineering organization tackling some of the most ambitious challenges in healthcare technology.

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and scale the full technology ecosystem behind our platform — React front-ends, Node services, mobile apps, browser extensions, and high-performance AI systems — with state-of-the-art developer-focused AI tools that dramatically increase your velocity and technical reach.

This is a critical role for someone who can ship across the full stack, partner directly with clinicians and administrators to see firsthand how their work improves care, and take on ownership quickly as the team scales. You will work closely with product, design, AI/ML, and customer-facing teams to translate real clinician needs into high-impact solutions.

This is not a narrowly-scoped, single-stack engineering role. You should be comfortable moving across front-end, back-end, mobile, and AI-driven systems, leveraging modern AI developer tools to move fast, and operating with real autonomy in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment.

We believe successful engineers here are defined not by narrow specialization, but by ownership, technical judgment, and the real-world impact of what they ship — whether that's leading a single feature or, over time, owning an entire product area. Whether your path leads toward principal engineering, staff IC, or future team leadership, you'll have the autonomy, resources, and AI-enabled leverage to get there faster.

What You'll Own

Ship across the stack.
Architect, develop, and ship new features across our full technology ecosystem — React front-ends, Node services, mobile apps (iOS/Android), browser extensions, and AI-driven infrastructure — owning major components from design through deployment with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
Partner cross-functionally.
Collaborate directly with product, design, AI/ML, and customer-facing teams to translate real clinician needs into high-impact solutions.
Accelerate with AI.
Leverage advanced developer-focused AI tools to speed up development, improve code quality, and strengthen system reliability.
Drive innovation.
Contribute to internal hackathons, rapid prototyping, and stay ahead of industry trends to identify technologies and opportunities that set the standard.
Shape technical strategy.
Lead technical decisions, contribute to architectural strategy, and help define engineering patterns as we grow the platform.
Mentor and elevate the team.
Mentor other engineers, raise the bar on best practices, and help build a strong, supportive engineering culture.
Own end-to-end.
Drive end-to-end ownership of key product areas and help build and scale new teams as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

Full-Stack Range.
You move comfortably across front-end, back-end, mobile, and browser-extension code, and you don't need to be told which layer a problem lives in.
Sharp Technical Judgment.
You design clean, scalable architecture, anticipate problems before they get expensive, and make pragmatic tradeoffs under real constraints.
AI-Accelerated Execution.
You use modern AI developer tools as real leverage to build faster and better, not as a crutch.
Ownership & Autonomy.
You drive your own work forward in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment without waiting to be told what's next.
Cross-Functional Fluency.
You partner naturally with product, design, and customer-facing teams, translating real clinician needs into shipped solutions.
Mentorship & Craft.
You raise the technical bar for the people around you, whether that's one engineer or an entire team.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of full-stack development experience, with a strong history of delivering production-grade systems from concept to launch.
Proficiency in our core stack — TypeScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB — with deep front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM manipulation, Fetch/XHR) and expertise in browser extensions or similar browser-integrated technologies.
Expertise designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs, with strong familiarity across NoSQL data models.
Sharp problem-solving skills with the ability to design clean, scalable architecture and anticipate technical challenges.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and product intuition — comfortable partnering with both technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with CI/CD (GitHub Actions), version control best practices, and modern DevOps workflows.
A strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive work with autonomy in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with AI/ML pipelines, LLMs, model evaluation, or data processing workflows.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, GCP, Helm, Terraform, and distributed systems.
Background developing mobile applications (iOS/Android) or integrating with cross-platform frameworks.
Experience in fast-paced startup environments, especially where engineers hold significant ownership.
History of building projects independently — open source, side projects, research, or entrepreneurial work.
Familiarity with healthcare, clinical documentation workflows, or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2, NIST, ISO frameworks, etc.).
Experience designing systems that balance usability, accuracy, and performance at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $110,000–$140,000 (based on experience) + equity

Actual compensation will depend on experience, scope, and overall alignment with the role. Equity participation is an important component of our compensation philosophy.

We offer competitive compensation, stock options, unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, and a 401(k) with company match and Roth option.

jobs.description:
If you want to be part of a dynamic team delivering cutting-edge cyber training solutions, this is the place for you. Amentum is seeking a Software Engineer to join the DevOps team in Hanover, MD. The team develops, deploys, and supports mission-focused cyber training solutions used across multiple locations.

Team members work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment supporting the entire software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software development, testing, deployment, infrastructure management, and operational support. Engineers work closely with instructors, developers, and system administrators to deliver reliable, realistic training capabilities.

Unlike many software organizations where engineers are assigned to a single product or technology stack, members of the DevOps team contribute across a diverse portfolio of applications, services, and supporting infrastructure. This provides opportunities to build broad technical expertise while collaborating with teammates to deliver integrated solutions throughout the software development lifecycle.

This position is ideal for software engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, learning new technologies, and applying their skills across a diverse portfolio of software, infrastructure, and operational systems. you. 

Work Schedule:
The courses being supported are active from 0700-1800 M-F. Contract core hours are 1000-1400. The DevOps team is flexible on arrival and departure time however there are occasions where one or more DevOps team members will be needed to support testing and maintenance before or after course hours.

Essential Responsibilities:

The Software Engineer will contribute to the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of software applications and supporting infrastructure. Team members are expected to broaden their experience across multiple areas of the software development lifecycle while developing technical expertise in one or more areas.

Responsibilities include:

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain software applications supporting cyber training environments.
Analyze requirements and develop technical solutions that support mission and customer needs.
Develop user interfaces, backend services, APIs, automation tools, and data processing solutions.
Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of software development pipelines.
Configure, deploy, and maintain applications in virtualized and containerized environments.
Develop and maintain databases, dataflows, scripts, and automation solutions.
Support the creation and maintenance of realistic cyber training environments and simulations.
Perform software testing, debugging, validation, and analysis of results.
Evaluate new technologies and contribute recommendations for improving applications and development processes.
Document software designs, configurations, processes, and operational procedures.
Collaborate with instructors, developers, system administrators, and other technical teams to improve training capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve existing applications, workflows, and user experiences.

Security Clearance Required:
TS/SCI with Poly

Minimum Education:

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and two (2) years of relevant experience;

OR

Bachelor's degree in the same fields and five (5) years of relevant experience;

OR Associate's degree (or 18 semester hours of military coursework/training in a computer-related field) and seven (7) years of relevant experience;

OR High school diploma/GED and nine (9) years of relevant experience.

Minimum Years of Experience:

Experience developing using one or more of the following languages: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Java, or C++.

     Requires demonstrated proficiency in web UI interface design using a variety of languages such as HTML, CSS, AJAX, JSON/XML, JavaScript/TypeScript, and JQuery or similar.
     Experience using SQL/NoSQL and relational databases (MySQL/MongoDB preferred) required.
     A working knowledge of both Windows and Linux platform is required.

Preferred Qualifications:
The DevOps team positions require fully cleared individuals with an extensive range of experience and abilities to develop applications for Computer Network Operations. As a team we implement and support all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle and recognize the benefit of having team members that specialize in specific stages of that cycle. As a team member you should be able to fit into at least one of the following specializations (UI/UX, Backend Services, DevOps/Integration) with a desire or ability to expand into at least one other specialization. 

UI/UX specialist: Focus on designing and creating the student and instructor facing interfaces and need the following skills at a minimum: 

 develop aesthetically pleasing and user-friendly front ends using frameworks like react, angular, and svelte 
 develop and implement test beds and use test suites such as jUnit or PyTest for robust testing practices 
interface with API endpoints, databases, and other dataflow solutions 
 perform trend analysis of student activities and identify potential improvements to course delivery systems and interfaces. 

Backend Service specialist: Focus on creating dataflow components to collect, parse, and provide information to other services or for exfiltration and deliverables. You will need the following skills at a minimum: 

develop services, APIs and dataflow solutions using various languages and frameworks such as Python Flask, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.JS, Express/Hono, PHP, Ruby on Rails, and Go. 
design and implement database schemas across multiple systems with and without replication using SQL and NoSQL solutions 
develop scripts, scrapers and parsers in support of automated grading and course delivery 
 develop and implement test beds and use test suites such as jUnit or PyTest for robust testing practices 
 administer, configure, and maintain common Unix/Linux and Windows Server variants 
 create and configure virtual hosts and networks using VMware in support of developing real-world scenarios 

DevOps/Integration specialist: Focus on the management and maintenance of the virtualization and deployment solutions used to ensure rapid validated deployments of services and applications. You will need the following skills at a minimum: 

 design and implement flexible and robust CI/CD pipelines to enhance the software development lifecycle using solutions such as GitLab 
plan, implement, and maintain scalable application and service deployments in an on-premises Kubernetes clusters using tools like helm, fleet, git, rancher, lens, or k9s 
develop and deploy applications, services, and systems within virtualized environments, preferably vSphere, Docker, and Kubernetes 
support API and dataflow systems 
perform HTTPS certificate management 
design service, application, and network architectures to support deployment and data flow 
 develop and implement test beds and use test suites such as jUnit or PyTest for robust testing practices 

All team members regardless of their specialization will be expected to: 

demonstrate the ability to parse and understand existing code bases, contributing to the continued development of class management tools 
 perform trend analysis of student activities and identify potential improvements to course delivery systems and interfaces 
 develop software solutions using languages such as Python, Shell scripting or Node.js 
 develop and deploy applications, services, and systems within virtualized environments such as vSphere and Docker 
 create and manage applications using industry standard package managers (apt, yum, pip, npm, nuget, etc…) 
show proficiency in using source code management systems, with a focus on Git 
apply valid software development pipelines to develop, test, document and deploy projects 
use and receive tasking through project management systems such as Jira or GitLab 
provide comprehensive documentation and support for various levels of customers 
be a self-motivated individual that can think outside the box to stay ahead of issues that could prevent the successful delivery of course material and activities while supporting the team as a whole 
learn about the other specializations to better work with and support other development efforts 
provide recommendations for technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems 
 lead development activities, showcasing the ability to guide and manage software engineering projects 
mentor junior team members

The Role at a Glance

The Agentic Platform Engineer builds the shared cloud platform and engineering foundations that enable AIDA teams to deliver secure, scalable AI agents and agentic applications. This role focuses on the runtime, tooling, and guardrails that agents depend on: model access, tool and context integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, observability, and DevSecOps on AWS.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and maintain shared platform services that support agent runtimes, LLM gateways, model routing, prompt/context management, and tool integration.
Standardize agentic delivery patterns including tool/function calling, MCP-style tool servers, retrieval pipelines, memory and state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
Implement guardrails for agent safety: input/output filtering, prompt injection defenses, human-in-the-loop approval paths, sandboxed execution, and least-privilege agent identities.
Improve developer productivity through CI/CD, environment templates, agent scaffolding, SDKs, and platform automation.
Build observability and evaluation for agentic systems: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency, quality/eval harnesses, and regression testing of prompts and agent behavior.
Manage cost-aware model consumption, rate limits, caching, and secure secrets/access patterns across environments.
Partner with architecture, security, risk, and engineering leaders to apply AI controls, interoperability standards, and governance guardrails.
Document platform standards and help delivery teams adopt agentic patterns consistently.

What We’re Looking For

Must Haves:

5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, with hands-on work building or operating AI/LLM-based applications.
Strong experience with AWS, including services supporting AI workloads (Bedrock, SageMaker, containers, serverless).
Practical experience with agent frameworks and LLM tooling such as LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
Strong coding ability in Python; Java or NodeJS is a plus.
Experience enabling engineering teams through CI/CD, GitLab, observability, reusable services, and platform standards.
Experience with API infrastructure, containers, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling.

Nice to Haves

Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, or similar).
Experience supporting production systems, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads.
Exposure to regulated enterprise environments, identity/access controls, AI risk frameworks, and audit logging.

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/30/26 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

What’s it like to work here?

At Lincoln Financial, we love what we do. We make meaningful contributions each and every day to empower our customers to take charge of their lives. jobs.description:
Hi ,

Hope You are doing great !!

We are currently hiring for the following opportunity that may align with your expertise: please let me know if you are interested or open to the job market so you can reply over the same email or you can directly reach me at mohan@hireontech.com / 214 7719902.

Role/Skills:
Data Engineer, GCP, HL7, HIN Transaction

Work Site:
Nashville, Tennessee( Hybrid Role - 3 Days Onsite)

Detailed Job Description :

As a Consulting Data Engineer, you will architect, build, and optimize the next generation of our real-time healthcare data platforms and event-driven architectures. You will play a foundational role in moving our clinical, operational, and financial data away from legacy batch processing toward high-throughput, near-zero-latency streaming pipelines.
In this role, you will champion modern data engineering practices, design highly scalable cloud-native pipelines, and mentor a growing team of engineers. You will bridge the gap between complex electronic health records (EHR) and data consumer-enabling data scientists, software engineers, and clinical analysts to securely access, stream, and query compliant data at scale to improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency.
Core Responsibilities

Architect Real-Time Pipelines: Design, implement, and monitor high-throughput, fault-tolerant streaming pipelines that ingest and process millions of concurrent healthcare data events (e.g., live telemetry, HL7 feeds, ADT messages).
Scale Google Cloud Infrastructure: Build and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud data infrastructure using Google Cloud healthcare-native tools and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Enforce Healthcare Compliance & Security: Uphold strict data security protocols (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2) by building robust data lakehouse architectures that enforce PHI/PII masking, role-based access control (RBAC), and encryption at rest and in transit.
Enable Self-Service Data & Interoperability: Build out streaming data ecosystems that support modern healthcare interoperability, managing real-time data catalogs and schema registries.
Promote Code Excellence: Write modular, highly reusable, and performance-tested code; lead code reviews and establish standardized CI/CD automated deployment workflows.
Optimize Data Reliability: Set and champion strict SLAs for clinical data delivery, establish automated data-quality testing, and implement proactive system monitoring and alerting.
Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with Data Architects, Clinical Product Managers, and AI/ML teams to translate healthcare requirements into technical blueprints while mentoring mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Education

13+ years of experience in dedicated data engineering, data architecture, or distributed systems software engineering roles.
4+ years of experience specifically within the healthcare domain (payer, provider, digital health, or health tech).
Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (or equivalent proven expert-level architecture experience on GCP).

True Streaming Focus

Advanced Event-Driven Architecture: Mastery of high-volume streaming technologies including Apache Kafka and Google Cloud Pub/Sub for decoupled, real-time message routing.
Stream Processing: Deep hands-on experience with Apache Flink or Google Cloud Dataflow (Apache Beam) for real-time streaming, complex event processing (CEP), windowing, and streaming data transformations.

Healthcare-Specific Tech Stack

Interoperability Standards: Deep expertise working with FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) JSON structures, HL7 v2/v3 messaging, and DICOM imaging standard streams.
GCP Healthcare Tools: Hands-on experience implementing and scaling the Google Cloud Healthcare API (specifically FHIR stores and HL7v2 stores).
EHR Integration: Experience integrating streaming pipelines with major EHR systems (such as Epic, Cerner, or Meditech).

Cloud Ecosystem & Modern Tooling

Google Cloud Ecosystem: Technical mastery of BigQuery (including partitioning, clustering, and streaming inserts), Cloud Storage, Dataproc, and Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow).
Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java, with a strong focus on writing optimized code for distributed computing platforms (like Spark or Beam).
Modern Data Stack & Modeling: Mastery of modern analytics engineering frameworks (such as dbt), dimensional data modeling, and lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
DevOps & Automation: Robust experience building automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and managing infrastructure using Terraform.
